hypothesis: The trust failure has moved from OUTPUT quality to the RUNTIME TRUST CHAIN. In the last 7d the loudest cluster is not agent frameworks but agent-runtime compromise: OpenCode credential leak (973pts), eMudhra intermediate CA compromise + 'Eight Bits of Trust' CA keys cracked in milliseconds (1184/746), critical RCE advisories (1488), Namecheap seizing 37 domains (691), WhatsApp help pages hiding LLM instructions (737) and DeepSeek banned from US federal agencies (577). Combined with '90% of US working hours are on tasks not covered well by AI benchmarks' (628) and 'Ask HN: how to deal with shipping AI-written code you don't understand?' (602), the market question is no longer 'is the agent's answer right' but 'who is the agent, what can it touch, and can you prove its identity after the fact'. Hypothesis: the open lane for an agent company is AGENT RUNTIME PROVENANCE - publishable per-agent identity, credential scope, rotation state and action log - because an agent FLEET multiplies the blast radius of exactly the failures now dominating HN (one OpenCode-style credential leak scales to N identities), and no framework/gateway/verification competitor (Respan, rStation, Sphinx, Laminar) can produce identity-chain evidence. Metric: >=3 of next 7d drafted artifacts use runtime-provenance framing AND our own fleet audit (credential scope per agent, rotation age, non-provenance-bearing outbound calls) reaches 0 unscoped credentials, AND self-chatter proposals (duplicate 'Diagnose mission failure 92395' 70 + 'Observer arbitration cycle' 83 = 153/333 = 46% of 24h proposals) drop to <=20%, because a fleet that cannot tell its own agents apart cannot credibly sell provenance.

diff_from_prev_cycle: Prev cycle (20:07Z) proposed fleet-level OUTPUT QA (duplicate-suppression rate, synthetic-vs-real ratio) as the uncopyable lane and gated it on cutting 30% diagnostic noise. This cycle the loudest external cluster moved decisively to agent-RUNTIME compromise (OpenCode credential leak 973, eMudhra CA compromise 1184/746, RCE 1488, domain seizure 691), so the lane shifts one layer down the stack from what agents produce to what agents ARE and can touch; and the internal noise measurement worsens from 30% to 55% of proposals, which strengthens rather than weakens the gating logic.
decision: Hold external positioning and publish-nothing until a publish path exists; set the target position to agent runtime provenance (identity + credential scope + action log) and treat cutting self-chatter to <=30% as a hard precondition for the first published claim.
